post.description:
Export a case's full audit trail as a JSON bundle or a self-contained HTML doc.

The bundle carries the case header, its linked alerts (with grouping
rationale), every note, and the whole ``case:{case_id}`` hash-chained event
stream plus a ``chain_verified`` flag. The export is *itself* audited: a
``case.audit_exported`` event is appended to the stream and committed before
the response is returned (so it is not part of the bundle just built).
Recompute + tip-anchor every audit stream; report the broken ones.
Ingest one alert. ``201`` when created, ``200`` on an idempotent replay.

Bulk-ingest alerts; grouping is deferred to one async ``group_alerts_job``.

Each item is validated independently (rejects are reported, not fatal), each
valid item is persisted with per-item dedup, the batch commits once, and a
single ARQ job is enqueued with the ids of the newly-created alerts. ``202``.

The enqueue is best-effort: if Redis is unreachable the alerts are still
durably persisted and the route still returns ``202`` with
``grouping_enqueued: false`` / ``job_id: null``. Un-grouped alerts
(``case_id IS NULL``) can be re-grouped later by re-enqueuing
``group_alerts_job`` with their ids; a periodic sweep is a Phase-2 item.

AssignRequest.title: AssignRequest
AssignRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/assign``.

``assignee_id`` is required but nullable: pass a user id to assign, or an
explicit ``null`` to unassign. The user must exist and be active.

CaseDetailOut.title: CaseDetailOut
CaseDetailOut.description:
``GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}`` -- the case header plus its collections.

``alerts`` are the linked alerts (oldest event first), each with its
``grouping`` rationale from the ``GroupingDecision`` that linked it. ``notes``
are every note on the case (retracted included), oldest first. ``timeline`` is
the case's audit stream, newest first.

CaseListItem.title: CaseListItem
CaseListItem.description:
One row of ``GET /api/v1/cases`` -- a case header plus two joined fields.

``assignee_email`` is a LEFT JOIN onto ``users``; ``oldest_alert_event_time``
is the case's earliest linked ``alert.event_time`` (``None`` when no alert is
linked yet).

TransitionRequest.title: TransitionRequest
TransitionRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/transition``.

``to`` is the target status; ``reason`` is required (route-enforced) only for
a ``Closed`` -> ``In Progress`` re-open; ``disposition`` is required for a
close and must be one of the configured dispositions.
